skill.summary: AI-powered cloud service mapping and provider recommendation across Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Multi-Cloud Service Mapper & Decision Advisor.
- Provides AI-powered recommendations for mapping workloads to services across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.
- Supports workload analysis with custom priorities, industry and team context, and provider recommendations with confidence scores.
- Exposes endpoints for workload analysis, service category discovery, provider metadata, and health checks.
- Offers tiered pricing plans from free to enterprise level.
- Designed for organizations evaluating multi-cloud strategies and migrations.
